items.title: 67426_Hayes Pillars oral history interview
items.q: He joined our band back in '28.

ctx.x: And Stuff and myself, we -- at times we used to room together, you know. And we would get our -- he would get his fiddle out and I'd get my horn out, and we -- all we thought of was, you know, playing music. We just played practically all day. We just played all day, you know. And we enjoyed it, see. Great guy.
There was another guy named Irving Ervin Randolph from St. Louis. Irving Ervin Randolph -- I don't know where he was born, but we met him here in St. Louis. He joined our band back in '28.
Beautiful trumpet player. Cab Calloway took him too. Now, I don't know where he is now, see. I'm just giving you a taste of the caliber of musicians that we had at that time.
